text:
iris: Hey runtime team — quick bench QA ask for the launch post + webinar. Need a small, auditable smoke pack we can cite and hand to sales if leads come in. Can we get this by tomorrow morning?
nate: Yep, we can run something. What exactly do you need inside the pack?
iris: Minimal acceptance pack: manifest (model tag + exact checksum + kernel flags), per-request CSV with latency + token counts, 8 token-level traces (sampled), README with reproducible run command, and a single PNG with p50/p95/p99 bars for the deck. Also include a one-line suggested “sales blurb” for inbound leads.
mariana: Which model, quant, hardware, and traffic profile? Also warmup behaviour?
iris: Use model=launch-demo-2026 (I will DM checksum). Variants: int8 + fp16. Hardware: h100-medium. Short demo: 256 tokens @50 qps; long-context slide: 2048 tokens streaming @10 qps plus a non-streaming run. Warmup: 3 warmup windows then steady-state. Seed: mkting-seed-2026 (I'll drop it in #marketing-assets).
ops-runner: OK. We'll capture coldstart + warmed steady-state for the short demo, and streaming vs non-streaming for long. We'll produce artifact: manifest.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces_8.csv, README.md, pstats_slide.png, and a sales_blurb.txt.
cleo: For the sales blurb, what tone? short CTA or technical callout?
iris: Short CTA plus technical anchor: something like "Demo shows median latency ~70ms (256 tokens, H100/int8). If you want to evaluate for your workload, contact sales@redwood.com and we'll run a tailored proof-of-performance."
nate: Good. We'll include cache-hit-rate and a small GPU util summary in the manifest so you can explain cold vs warm differences. Also a one-line variance caveat: "single-run smoke; expect ±10% on p95 due to scheduler and cache."
mariana: Do you want token-level traces for all variants or just a representative variant? Token traces are heavy.
iris: Representative variant only (int8 warmed). Token traces: 8 mixed-length requests. Per-request aggregates for everything else.
ops-runner: Queued job 301234 on h100-medium. Estimated smoke runtime ~55m. We'll upload to gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5211110000/smoke_pack.tar.gz when done. runtime-bot: job 301234 queued.
iris: Timeline works — need the smoke pack by 9am PT tomorrow to lock the deck and the launch blurb.
ops-runner: ETA upload by 08:15 PT tomorrow (smoke pack); full sweep (all kernel flags and int4 experimental) will follow if you need it.
cleo: Quick QA checklist for marketing to validate when the artifact lands: 1) confirm manifest checksum matches the model we expect; 2) verify p50/p95/p99 numbers map to the PNG; 3) check sales_blurb.txt to make sure the CTA is correct; 4) spot-check token traces for obvious decode glitches. I'll put that checklist in Notion.
iris: Perfect — will audit on arrival and flag here if we need a rerun (e.g., adjust qps or toggle prefix cache).
ops-runner: runtime-bot: job 301234 finished successfully. upload: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5211110000/smoke_pack.tar.gz (3.6MB). logs: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5211110000/logs/301234.log
iris: Downloading now. Will run the QA checklist and post acceptance by 08:45 PT if all good. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
mariana: If you need a one-off tailored run for a lead, ops-runner can quote turnaround time in the manifest (usually 2-4 hours depending on queue).
nate: Adding a short reproducible example to the README so external auditors can rerun locally:
```
MODEL=launch-demo-2026 CHECKSUM=sha256:xxxx... RUN_SEED=mkting-seed-2026 ./bench/run_smoke.sh --qps 50 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
iris: Great — this should let us lock the narrative and have arms to support inbound interest.
